text: Land clearing began in 1825. What effect did it have on the two populations?
html: Land clearing began in 1825. What effect did it have on the two populations?
answerHtml:
Worked solution

Both populations generally decline after 1825. Wombats fall steadily toward a low around 1925; potoroos fluctuate but also have a lower long-term level before recovering. The graph suggests an association; it does not prove land clearing was the only cause.

text: A newspaper calls 1000 randomly selected people across 20 electorates to ask their voting intentions. Assuming the selection and responses are representative, this is an example of what?
html: A newspaper calls 1000 randomly selected people across 20 electorates to ask their voting intentions. Assuming the selection and responses are representative, this is an example of what?
answerHtml:
Worked solution

Only part of the population is surveyed, so it is a sample. Random, representative selection aims to avoid selection bias. Under the stated assumption the intended answer is an unbiased sample; random selection does not guarantee a bias-free result.
